visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright kitchen where a pair of hands uses a metal spatula to transfer freshly baked, golden-brown buns speckled with black sesame seeds from a dark baking tray onto a wire cooling rack. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the soft texture of the bread. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a bread machine where a smooth, pale dough ball is being kneaded. A small white bowl then pours a generous amount of black sesame seeds onto the dough, which are quickly integrated. (3) On a white marble countertop, a person wearing translucent plastic gloves uses a white plastic scraper to divide the sesame-speckled dough into smaller portions, then rolls them into neat spheres. (4) The dough balls are arranged on a parchment-lined tray, and a small blade is used to score a cross on the top of each. A metal spoon then carefully drizzles golden olive oil into the scores. (5) After baking, the buns are moved back to the cooling rack, and a green silicone brush is used to coat the tops with more olive oil, giving them a glossy finish. (6) In a black frying pan, two eggs are fried sunny-side up. Subsequently, two halves of a sesame bun are placed in the pan to be toasted until the edges are crisp and golden. (7) The sandwich is assembled on a black board: a bun half is spread with a yellow condiment using a small white spatula, followed by a large green lettuce leaf, a fried egg, a red tomato slice, and several green avocado slices. (8) A white spray bottle misting oil and a black pepper grinder are used over the sandwich ingredients. The completed sandwich is shown plated on a pink dish next to other buns. (9) Finally, leftover buns are sliced in half with a large knife and tucked into a translucent silicone storage bag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy J-Pop music featuring a male vocalist singing in Japanese over a bright, synth-driven track with a strong 4/4 drum beat. There is a low ambient kitchen hum in the background. (2) A subtle sizzling sound is introduced as the eggs hit the pan, blending with the rhythmic beat of the music. The vocals remain upbeat and melodic. (3) A distinct 'click' or tapping sound of chopsticks against the toasted bun surface is heard, marking a phase shift. The music continues at a steady 128 BPM. (4) A short, airy 'whoosh' or spray sound occurs as oil is misted over the sandwich, followed by the mechanical clicking sound of a pepper grinder. (5) A sharp 'crunch' sound is audible as a knife slices through the crusty bread, layered under the final chorus of the song.
